sentences.text:

 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Ms. Neetu Prajapati - Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Vineeta Sharma - Panel lawyer for the State.
 Order

This is third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.211/2023 dated 11.07.2023 registered at Police Station Padam Nagar Khandwa, District Khandwa for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 506 of IPC and Sections 7/8, 5L/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in custody and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that applicant is permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of his absconding from the clutches of law or tampering with prosecution evidence.
He also submits that the applicant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which 2 MCRC-22402-2024 may be imposed by this Court.
Upon these grounds, the applicant may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
The earlier two were dismissed as M.Cr.C. No.42787/2023 and 54977/2023.
While dismissing the second bail application, this Court had observed that the DNA report was still awaited.

During the pendency of this bail application, the Court directed the State to file the DNA report and the same has been received which is positive in nature showing that the 'Y'
chromosome DNA profile recovered from the source of prosecutrix matched with the DNA profile of applicant.
